title: fix(service-analytics): a dataset over a field named after a SQL keyword (order, group, select) answers rows instead of 500
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU5CHkeh2msc49m4dh6kwEt)_

Fixes #33138

Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3.

## What changes

`NativeSQLStrategy.qualifyAndRegisterJoin` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts`) wrote a plain base-table column **bare** whenever the statement joined nothing, and `"<table>"."<column>"` when it joined. It now writes it quoted in both cases: `"<column>"` unjoined, `"<table>"."<column>"` joined (unchanged). Expressions, dotted paths and `*` are untouched.

Measured first (the triage's p1 trigger), real ObjectQL + SQLite, REST door and `query_dataset` tool, at `origin/main` `e540baf8`:

| field name | lookup dimension (`field: <name>`) | relationship path (`<name>.region`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `order` | **500 `DATABASE_ERROR`** → 200 | 200 (unchanged) |
| `group` | **500** → 200 | 200 |
| `select` | **500** → 200 | 200 |
| `user` (CONTROL) | 200 | 200 |
| `cb_order` (CONTROL) | 200 | 200 |

The path form already worked because a joining statement quotes. `user` passes on SQLite but is `CURRENT_USER` on PostgreSQL when bare, so a base dimension named `user` would group every row under the database role there (read from PostgreSQL's grammar, NOT MEASURED on a server). The MCP `query_dataset` door failed the same way as REST (same compile).

## Why

A bare identifier is the only spelling in this compiler that is not quoted; tables, aliases and joined columns already are. One rule (always quote a column) removes the whole keyword class on every dialect instead of a per-dialect reserved-word list.

## Verification

- New `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-keyword-field-name.test.ts`: 5 field names × 2 shapes, three faces each (REST door, `query_dataset` executor, direct service), all serve the labelled rows. Ablation (quote removed in the unjoined branch, `service-analytics` rebuilt): `order`/`group`/`select` lookup-dimension cases red (`3 failed | 7 passed`), CONTROLs green; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, rebuilt.
- `service-analytics` test-text updates (29 files, assertions only): SQL-text pins of the native compiler now read `"col"`. Where a test compares the native compiler with the ObjectQL echo (which still prints bare columns; it is display text, never executed), the helper reads the quotes away (`analytics-faces-one-lowering`, `text-match-mssql-oracle`) or quotes the expected native text (`where-boolean-flag-refusal`). No assertion was removed or loosened.
- Local on the branch: `service-analytics` full suite `5199 passed | 332 skipped`; `rest` new file + `analytics-dataset-lookup-dimension-labels` `16 passed`; `service-analytics` and `rest` typecheck, eslint on every touched file, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`: exit 0. Rest: CI.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Changeset `.changeset/33138-analytics-keyword-field-name.md`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- A cube member whose `sql` is a bare SQL keyword function (e.g. `CURRENT_DATE`) is now read as a column in an unjoined statement too. It already was in any joining statement, and the compiler's own rule is that a plain identifier is a column; no first-party cube writes one.
- The ObjectQL echo (`ObjectQLStrategy.generateSql`) still prints bare columns. It is the display of what the engine ran, not SQL that executes; quoting it is cosmetic and left out of this PR.
